events.name: Brock's Rest Stop
events.intro: A camp by the road. Brock is stirring a big pot and waves you over. "Stew's almost ready. Hungry?"

success.text: Warm and filling. Everyone feels better, and Brock is reaching for his secret spice...

failure.text: Brock gets distracted and burns the whole pot. "Uh... next time!"

success.text: You thank Brock and keep walking.

events.name: Brock's Secret Spice
events.intro: Brock holds up a little jar. "Pick a stat. The spice only works if I get it just right."

success.text: Perfect! Your team's Attack is boosted for the next boss fight.

effects.label: Brock's stew: Attack x1.5 in the next boss fight

failure.text: A pinch too much. The spice does nothing special, but the stew was good.

success.text: Perfect! Your team's Defense is boosted for the next boss fight.

effects.label: Brock's stew: Defense x1.5 in the next boss fight

failure.text: A pinch too much. The spice does nothing special, but the stew was good.

success.text: Perfect! Your team's Sp. Atk is boosted for the next boss fight.

effects.label: Brock's stew: Sp. Atk x1.5 in the next boss fight

failure.text: A pinch too much. The spice does nothing special, but the stew was good.

success.text: Perfect! Your team's Speed is boosted for the next boss fight.

effects.label: Brock's stew: Speed x1.5 in the next boss fight

failure.text: A pinch too much. The spice does nothing special, but the stew was good.

events.name: Pewter Museum of Science
events.intro: Fossils fill the glass cases. A curator beams at you. "Old Amber is on display. Answer my fossil quiz and it is yours."

success.text: The curator logs it in the Fossil Registry, pays you 300 coins and pins a Fossil Registry badge on you. The fossil stays yours for revival.

effects.text: Registered a fossil at the Pewter Museum of Science.

success.text: The curator logs it in the Fossil Registry, pays you 300 coins and pins a Fossil Registry badge on you. The fossil stays yours for revival.

effects.text: Registered a fossil at the Pewter Museum of Science.

success.text: Three for three! The curator hands over the Old Amber.

failure.text: Two wrong. "Come back when you have studied!"

success.text: Fascinating, but you have places to be.

events.name: Magikarp Salesman
events.intro: A man on Route 4 grins. "Psst! Magikarp for sale, only 500! Best Pokemon in the world!"

success.text: This Magikarp is something special: strong and quick in the water. Even the salesman looks surprised.

failure.text: A normal Magikarp. It flops. It uses Splash. The salesman is already gone.

success.text: "Your loss!" he calls after you.

events.name: Pewter Skies: The Flock
events.intro: A flock of Spearow dives at a lone Pidgey, and it cannot fight them all.

success.text: You jump in. The flock turns on you, wave after wave.
You keep walking. Behind you, the Pidgey's cries fade.

events.name: Veridian Forest
events.intro: The trees close in overhead. Somewhere ahead, an old swordsman is said to wait in a clearing. You can turn back before the first fight.

success.text: You step in.

failure.text: You step in. Something feels different today.

success.text: You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: Veridian Forest: A Strange Turn
events.intro: The forest is quiet. Too quiet. Branches creak overhead.

success.text: A thick fog rolls between the trees. Nobody can aim properly in here: accuracy drops for everyone until you leave the forest.

failure.text: A net drops on the party! Far above, a striped balloon drifts away over the trees.

effects.text: A striped balloon over Veridian Forest, with a net-launcher hanging under it.

events.name: Veridian Forest: Bug Catcher
events.intro: A Bug Catcher jumps out of the ferns, net first.

success.text: "My bugs are the best!"

events.name: Veridian Forest: The Forest Gift
events.intro: Something rustles in the grass: a Caterpie, a Weedle or a Pinsir. The forest is offering you a Bug-type. Catch it if you can.

success.text: You step toward the rustle.

choices.label: Step toward the rustle (in the fog)

success.text: The fog parts on something pale and empty-eyed.

failure.text: You step toward the rustle.

events.name: Veridian Forest: The Thicket
events.intro: A trail runs on, and to one side a thicket buzzes angrily.

success.text: A Bug Catcher blocks the trail.
A Beedrill swarm erupts out of the thicket!

failure.text: Only an empty nest. You rejoin the trail.

events.name: Veridian Forest: The Hollow Tree
events.intro: The trail bends past a huge hollow tree that smells of honey.

success.text: A Bug Catcher is waiting.
A den! Something big is guarding the honey.

failure.text: Just honey and bark. You move on.

events.name: Veridian Forest: The Clearing
events.intro: A clearing. A figure in old armor sits on a stump, very still. A Bug-type is the only thing that will be welcome here.

success.text: The figure lifts his head and looks at your Bug-type.

choices.label: Step into the clearing (a Weedle was waiting)

success.text: A Weedle that was already waiting for you crawls up your leg. The figure on the stump watches it.

events.name: Veridian Forest: The Samurai
events.intro: "One Pokemon against one. Same level. No items, no switching. Show me your Bug-type."

success.text: The Samurai draws a blade. The duel begins.

events.name: Mt. Moon
events.intro: A cave mouth, cool and echoing. Somewhere inside, a skylight lets the moon in. You can turn back before the first fight.

success.text: You step into the dark.
You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: Mt. Moon: The Mouth
events.intro: Zubat flutter overhead as you go in.

success.text: Something stirs in the dark.

events.name: Mt. Moon: The Hiker
events.intro: A Hiker is resting against the wall, boots off.

success.text: "Mt. Moon is my second home!"

events.name: Mt. Moon: Deeper In
events.intro: The tunnel narrows. Pebbles trickle down from the ceiling.

success.text: A wild shape scrambles out of a crack.

events.name: Mt. Moon: Moon Watching (1 of 3)
events.intro: Midnight. A ring of Clefairy dance under the skylight. What do you do?

success.text: That felt right. The Clefairy relax.
The Clefairy scatter, startled.
The sudden noise spooks them.

events.name: Mt. Moon: Moon Watching (2 of 3)
events.intro: A Clefairy shyly holds out a shard of Moon Stone.

success.text: That felt right. The Clefairy relax.
It tilts its head, unsure.
It puts the shard back down.

events.name: Mt. Moon: Moon Watching (3 of 3)
events.intro: The smallest Clefairy hides behind your leg.

success.text: That felt right. The Clefairy relax.
It whimpers and runs off.
It squeaks and wriggles free.

events.name: Mt. Moon: The Clefairy's Gift
events.intro: The dance winds down. The smallest Clefairy looks up at you.

success.text: The Clefairy trots to your side, and it knows Moonblast.
The Clefairy trots to your side, and it knows Moonblast.

failure.text: It waves goodbye and leaves a Moon Stone shard behind.

choices.label: Meet its eyes (the dance is a blur)

success.text: It waves goodbye and leaves a Moon Stone shard behind.

events.name: Mt. Moon: Fossil Recovery
events.intro: A scientist is cracking something out of the wall with a little hammer. "Hey! This one is mine!"

success.text: "Then you will have to beat me for it!"

events.name: Mt. Moon: Gem-Stone Mine
events.intro: A wall of glittering ore deposits. A Fighting-type move would crack one open.

success.text: A Gem Vein! Rare Candy and a Metal Coat tumble out.

failure.text: The deposit cracks and an evolution stone drops out, but something heavy wakes behind it.

success.text: You hire a pickaxe from a man with too many of them and break one deposit open.

events.name: Mt. Moon: The Way Out
events.intro: Daylight again, far down the other side of the mountain.

success.text: You leave the mountain behind.

events.name: Cerulean: The Bridge
events.intro: A long bridge over the river, the only way on. Planks creak under the wind. You cannot go around.

success.text: The planks hold. Five trainers wait at the far end.

failure.text: The rope snaps. You fall into the river and the current carries you away.

events.name: Nugget Bridge: First Challengers
events.intro: The first three trainers step onto the planks. "Nobody crosses without a battle!"

success.text: Three trainers, one after another.

events.name: Nugget Bridge: The Last Two
events.intro: Two more trainers wait at the end of the bridge.

success.text: Two more fights.

events.name: Nugget Bridge: The Offer
events.intro: At the end of the bridge a man in black leans on the rail. "Nice work. We pay well, you know. There is a spot on our team with your name on it."

success.text: "Your loss," he shrugs, and tosses you a Nugget. He talks too much while he does.
"Wise choice," he grins. Then he throws a ball. It was a trap, and a free fight.

events.name: The Hidden Village
events.intro: You wake up in a quiet valley, wet and aching. The river brought you here. There is a village, and a rope hanging from the cliff.

success.text: Smoke rises from a few small houses.

events.name: The Hidden Village: Valley Path
events.intro: Tall grass fills the valley floor, and something is moving in it.

success.text: A wild Pokémon jumps out.

events.name: The Hidden Village: Valley Path
events.intro: Tall grass fills the valley floor, and something is moving in it.

success.text: A wild Pokémon jumps out.

events.name: The Hidden Village: The Square
events.intro: A small square with a healing pool, a shrine heaped with berries, and an old Elder on a bench. You have time for one of them.

success.text: The warm water takes every ache away.
The shrine keeper presses a few berries into your hands.
"Long ago, grass starters of every land came here to rest." You think about that for a while.

events.name: The Hidden Village: A Request
events.intro: A villager waves you over. "There is something we need help with. It will not take long."

success.text: You follow the villager.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Venusaur Garden
events.intro: A giant Venusaur droops in a wilting garden. Three Poison-type thieves are stripping its flowers.

success.text: The garden is saved. A Bulbasaur seedling looks up from beside the Venusaur.

events.name: Hidden Village: Bayleef's Dew
events.intro: The village lost its dew bottle. A sweet scent hangs in the air, and there are three trails to follow.

success.text: The trail ends at a Bayleef who was guarding the bottle all along.

failure.text: The trail goes cold in a flower bed.

success.text: It is only a chimney.

failure.text: You lose the trail among the houses.

choices.label: Follow the scent of the river

success.text: The bottle is stuck in the reeds, with a Chikorita sitting on it.

failure.text: You come back wet and empty-handed.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Rooftop Race
events.intro: An old Treecko dares you to cross the rooftops before it does. Three jumps.

choices.label: Jump slowly, one roof at a time

success.text: You make it, a step behind, and the elder is impressed that you finished at all.

failure.text: You slip on a wet tile.

choices.label: Run and leap on the beat

success.text: You nail every jump. The elder bows and sends a youngster over to join you.

failure.text: You miss the second jump.

success.text: The elder cheats. It was a test of whether you would copy.

failure.text: You trip on its tail.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Slow Planting
events.intro: A sapling needs planting. Then you must wait three turns of weather without touching it.

success.text: Three turns of rain and sun later, a small Turtwig sits under the leaves.

failure.text: You waited well, but the storm washed it out.

choices.label: Water it to speed things up

success.text: The sapling drowns.

failure.text: It rots in the mud.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Dignity Test
events.intro: A proud Snivy stands on a stump, chin high. It will only talk to someone with manners.

choices.label: Bow low and wait to be spoken to

success.text: The Snivy nods. A slight smile.

failure.text: The Snivy turns its back.

success.text: The Snivy stares at the hand.

failure.text: It turns away, offended.

success.text: It does not dignify that with a look.

failure.text: It leaves.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Feast
events.intro: A hungry Chespin sits by an empty bowl. A basket holds six ingredients, and it likes only some of them.

success.text: The Chespin devours it and hugs your leg.

failure.text: It sniffs and pushes the bowl away.

success.text: Too hot.

failure.text: It sneezes the bowl over.

success.text: The Chespin looks at you flatly.

failure.text: Not a good pick.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Night Watch
events.intro: The village sleeps. You must walk the night patrol without waking three sleeping Pokémon.

choices.label: Walk on tiptoe along the wall

success.text: Not a sound. A young Rowlet drops from a branch and falls into step.

failure.text: A Snorlax rolls over and the whole village hears it.

choices.label: Walk down the middle of the road

success.text: Every step echoes.

failure.text: You wake everyone.

success.text: You wake a sleeping Pokémon at once.

failure.text: Bad idea.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Jam Session
events.intro: A drum made of tree stumps. A Grookey beats a four-beat rhythm, and you must match it.

success.text: You match every beat. The Grookey laughs and joins your party.

failure.text: You lose count on the last beat.

success.text: Not the same rhythm.

failure.text: Wrong rhythm.

success.text: Close enough to try.

failure.text: The beat falls apart.

events.name: Hidden Village: The Berry Heist
events.intro: A Sprigatito snatched your berry and dashed off through the village. Three twists of the chase.

success.text: You run it down at the end of the lane.

events.name: The Hidden Village: The Rope
events.intro: The villagers lower a rope from the cliff. It leads back up to the bridge.

success.text: You climb back to the road. The village is already hard to see.

events.name: Squirtle Squad
events.intro: Sunglasses glint behind a hedge. A water balloon bursts at your feet. "Hey! You wanna play?"

success.text: The squad scatters, laughing, and then turns to fight.

failure.text: An Officer already has them in a row. "They have been causing trouble." But their boss is still around the corner.

success.text: You leave them to their pranks.

events.name: Squirtle Squad: The Fire Brigade
events.intro: Three Squirtle with sunglasses open a hose on you.

success.text: Three Squirtle in a row.

events.name: Squirtle Squad: The Wartortle
events.intro: A Wartortle steps out of the smoke, arms crossed.

success.text: Wartortle charges in.

events.name: Squirtle Squad: The Boss
events.intro: The squad parts. At the back, a Blastoise in sunglasses grins.

success.text: It braces its cannons.
The Blastoise sees you are no match yet and lets you pass, with a nod.

events.name: Squirtle Squad: The Shades
events.intro: The squad lines up. One of the Squirtle steps forward and hands you its sunglasses. It wants to come with you.

success.text: It slides on its shades and grins.

events.name: Damian's Unofficial Gym
events.intro: A hand-painted sign: "GYM. (Unofficial.)" A boy in a wet jacket waves you in. "Two of my friends first, then me. No pressure."

success.text: The door is held by a bucket.
You leave the unofficial gym to the pigeons.

events.name: Damian's Gym: The Swimmer
events.intro: A Swimmer cannonballs out of a paddling pool. "Round one!"

success.text: Splash!

events.name: Damian's Gym: The Fire Spirit
events.intro: A Fire Spirit trainer pops up beside a camping stove. "Round two. Mind the sparks."

success.text: Embers fly.

events.name: Damian's Gym: Damian
events.intro: Damian pulls a ball from his pocket. "I am not really a Leader. I just like battling."

success.text: Damian grins.

events.name: Cerulean: The Burglary
events.intro: A wall is smashed in and a Rocket Grunt runs out of the house with the family’s TM under one arm.

success.text: You catch up in an alley.
The family sighs at the hole in their wall.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain
events.intro: The rain started an hour ago. Somewhere ahead, in the dark, something small is shivering. This road does not let you pass without looking.

success.text: The rain gets heavier.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: Charmander
events.intro: A Charmander stands on a rock in the downpour, thin and soaked. It looks at you and does not run.

success.text: You pick it up. It is cold. Its flame is almost out. (Warmth 3 of 5)
You walk on. Nothing is gained, nothing is lost, and the rain keeps falling behind you.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The First Mile
events.intro: The Charmander shakes in your arms. The road ahead is flooded. Something rustles in the dark.

success.text: A wild Pokémon steps out of the rain.
You find a tarp with a dying fire under it. It is just enough.

failure.text: There is no fire anywhere, only more rain.

success.text: It eats the berry and stops shaking for a while.

choices.label: Check the soggy note on the fence post

success.text: You read it: a trainer is looking for a lost Pokémon, and it names the team they train.

failure.text: The ink has run. You cannot read a word of it.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The Long Dark
events.intro: Night. The rain has not eased. The Charmander stops shivering for a moment, and that is worse.

success.text: Another wild Pokémon, drawn by the light.

choices.label: Warm it with a Fire move

success.text: A small flame from your party keeps the shivering at bay.
It curls around the warm lump.

choices.label: Shelter under an overhang and wait

success.text: You wait out the worst of it.

failure.text: The overhang leaks. The cold wins a little.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The Last Stretch
events.intro: The lights of a house show through the rain. The Charmander is barely awake.

success.text: You carry it the last stretch, one step at a time.
It stops moving in your arms.

choices.label: Warm it with a Fire move

success.text: A small flame from your party keeps the shivering at bay.
It curls around the warm lump.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The Owner
events.intro: Damian, the boy who left it behind, is standing in the rain.

success.text: "Give it back." The Pokémon looks at you, not at them.

It curls around the warm lump.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The Owner
events.intro: The trainer who left it stands in the rain, wet and ashamed. They see the Pokémon in your arms and step forward.

success.text: "Give it back." The Pokémon looks at you, not at them.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: Chimchar
events.intro: A Chimchar stands on a rock in the downpour, thin and soaked. It looks at you and does not run.

success.text: You pick it up. It is cold. Its flame is almost out. (Warmth 3 of 5)
You walk on. Nothing is gained, nothing is lost, and the rain keeps falling behind you.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The First Mile
events.intro: The Chimchar shakes in your arms. The road ahead is flooded. Something rustles in the dark.

success.text: A wild Pokémon steps out of the rain.
You find a tarp with a dying fire under it. It is just enough.

failure.text: There is no fire anywhere, only more rain.

success.text: It eats the berry and stops shaking for a while.

choices.label: Check the soggy note on the fence post

success.text: You read it: a trainer is looking for a lost Pokémon, and it names the team they train.

failure.text: The ink has run. You cannot read a word of it.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The Long Dark
events.intro: Night. The rain has not eased. The Chimchar stops shivering for a moment, and that is worse.

success.text: Another wild Pokémon, drawn by the light.

choices.label: Warm it with a Fire move

success.text: A small flame from your party keeps the shivering at bay.
It curls around the warm lump.

choices.label: Shelter under an overhang and wait

success.text: You wait out the worst of it.

failure.text: The overhang leaks. The cold wins a little.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The Last Stretch
events.intro: The lights of a house show through the rain. The Chimchar is barely awake.

success.text: You carry it the last stretch, one step at a time.
It stops moving in your arms.

events.name: Cold Nights Rain: The Cold Wins
events.intro: You carry it as far as the house. The door opens. The owner takes the Pokémon from your arms, apologizing, and you are left standing in the rain. You go on.

success.text: The run goes on, and so do you.

events.name: Bill's Lighthouse
events.intro: A man at the dock says there is a lighthouse somewhere along the coast, and its keeper pays well for visitors who can find him. It is night. The beacon only shows in the dark.

success.text: You start along the shore.
You leave the dock behind.

events.name: Bill's Lighthouse: Clue 1
events.intro: Night on the coast. A light on the sea. There is a second sign pointing somewhere else.

choices.label: Follow: a light on the sea

success.text: You follow the glow to a buoy.

failure.text: It is a false trail. You walk back the way you came.

success.text: It happens to be right.

failure.text: It is a dead end. You walk back.

events.name: Bill's Lighthouse: Clue 2
events.intro: Night on the coast. A ship horn. There is a second sign pointing somewhere else.

success.text: You turn toward the sound.

failure.text: It is a false trail. You walk back the way you came.

success.text: It happens to be right.

failure.text: It is a dead end. You walk back.

events.name: Bill's Lighthouse: The Beacon
events.intro: At last, the coast bends. If you read the signs well, a light blinks from the headland.

success.text: The beacon is right in front of you.
You cannot find it. The coast goes dark.

events.name: Bill's Lighthouse: The Mishap
events.intro: A strange noise comes from the lighthouse. Inside, a Clefairy-shaped Pokémon waves its arms at a console and talks in Bill's voice.

success.text: There is a flash. Bill stands in front of you, himself again, very grateful.

effects.text: Rescued Bill from the Teleporter Mishap.

events.name: Route 5 Day-Care
events.intro: An old couple run a day-care on Route 5. "Leave a Pokémon with us for the day and we will bring out the best in it. A donation is fine."

choices.label: Leave your weakest for the day (₽150)

success.text: It comes back full of pride, and a little taller.
The old man comes back with an Egg in a blanket. "Two of yours got along well."
The couple wave you off.
